brief.audience: Viewers evaluating whether Framecraft can depict a credible, quiet desktop task with causal motion and local tactile sound.
brief.message: Small, deliberate actions make a working space feel settled.
references: Original exercise, not a client product. Observe conventional desktop title bars, focused rename fields, active-window stacking and cursor-to-window grip geometry; do not clone a branded OS.
brief.narrative: Establish a working desktop, create and name a folder, move its window with an attached hand cursor, then settle the camera and hold the result.
constraints: A labeled desktop simulation, not a working application or product claim.
No remote assets, narration or music.
Exact frame-driven states and variable typing cadence.
Subjective listening remains pending if unavailable; no automatic human approval.

palette: Warm paper #ebe8df for a quiet desk
Muted rust #a14323 only for active focus
design.typography: Local IBM Plex Sans for familiar, legible task controls; IBM Plex Serif for the two short editorial statements, adding a quiet printed-desk character. ENERGY 1 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 2.
design.composition: A persistent desktop with menu bar, overlapping windows, sidebar, file table and restrained elevation. The active window is the focal plane; no floating feature cards. The caption occupies the clear lower margin, outside the camera crop.
design.motion: Approach and settle before a press; release causes folder creation and focus. Variable key cadence resolves before confirmation. Preserve the title-bar grip throughout drag, release before the drop accent, and make one restrained camera move followed by a long reading hold.

beats.visual: An active file window sits in front of a reference window on a coherent desktop.
beats.motion: The arrow travels on a curved, decelerating approach, then settles over New folder.
beats.rationale: Establish task geometry before acting; the pointer should not compete with reading.

beats.visual: Press darkens New folder. Release creates a selected rename field.
beats.motion: A brief press, distinct release and visible focus precede typing.
beats.rationale: The consequence follows the input, not an arbitrary reveal timer.

beats.visual: Eleven characters form Field notes inside the focused field; confirmation ends editing.
beats.motion: Variable key cadence, then a readable pause and confirmation.
beats.rationale: Typing is an intentional task with focus, cadence and resolution.

beats.visual: The pointer approaches the title bar and changes to an open hand before contact.
beats.motion: Curved approach, settle, press, grip and short preparation before the drag.
beats.rationale: Show the intended handle and contact before moving a large object.

beats.visual: The front window follows the hand without changing its grip offset or losing stacking.
beats.motion: Ease into the drag and stop before release; a small drop accent follows the released contact.
beats.rationale: A window is not an elastic card. Its movement belongs to the pointer.

beats.visual: The folder remains selected in a settled workspace. The closing caption has a long reading hold.
beats.motion: One 2.5% motivated camera move settles by 348; closing type resolves by 370.
beats.rationale: Direct attention to the finished task without cropping menu text, then stop moving and let the viewer read.

events.detail: Cursor hotspot is inside New folder; button darkens only while pressed.

audio.reason: Dry light mechanical down-contact, not a notification.

events.detail: Release removes pressed state and creates the new folder.

audio.reason: A thinner, distinct up-contact follows the visible release.

events.detail: New folder's selected name receives a rust focus outline.

audio.reason: The release already conveys causality; another focus chime would be redundant.
Eleven original varied key contacts share the exact visual cadence.

events.detail: The final character is visible before confirmation.

audio.reason: The last contact is already part of the mapped typing performance.

events.detail: Confirmation clears the edit outline and caret while retaining folder selection.

audio.reason: A slightly lower keyboard contact resolves the naming action.

events.detail: Hand hotspot is at title-bar local 550,30; pressed state begins.

audio.reason: A separate original down-contact, not a repeat of the first click.

events.detail: Pressed hand retains the active foreground window and establishes its grip.

audio.reason: A low dry contact suggests a light grip before movement.

events.detail: Window and hand share the same eased translation through frame 286; attachment remains fixed.

audio.reason: Quiet filtered surface friction follows the drag envelope, with no sustained tone.

events.detail: Pointer and window stop together before release.

audio.reason: The friction envelope is already ending; no extra stop sound.

events.detail: Pressed state ends after the pointer/window movement has stopped.

audio.reason: A distinct up-contact ends the grip.

events.detail: The stationary window remains in front; the drop resolves the released action, with no rubber wobble.

audio.reason: A restrained low material contact and small secondary tap complete the gesture.

events.detail: One restrained camera move directs attention to the completed folder and stops by 348.

audio.reason: A quiet paper-brush accent marks the change of attention, not continuous camera noise.

events.detail: Camera is stationary, with menu labels inside the frame and closing type about to resolve.

audio.reason: Silence protects the closing reading hold.

events.detail: The closing caption is fully readable and all motion has stopped.

audio.reason: Let the final thought breathe; no success beep, voice or music.

quiet.reason: Orient and read before the first contact.
Focus is visible; do not add redundant sonic feedback.
Read the confirmed name while the pointer prepares its next action.
The camera settles and the closing thought holds without chatter.
